concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-address-update-node]] - Node.js customer-scoped Vault address update using customer and address IDs, callback `err`/`result` handling, alternative customer/payment-method update routes, and the missing-address or missing-customer error route
warnings: Keep address identity customer-scoped: the direct update example passes both a customer ID and an address ID.
Do not infer result fields or a success condition from the callback parameter name or the unread Address response-object link.

Do not import omitted-attribute semantics or other behavior from the separate customer-update source; this page only states that customer and payment-method updates are alternative routes for updating an address.
